theme.tone: Solemn institutions normalize increasingly absurd technology.
theme.escalationRule: Each Era should feel one step less reasonable while every rule remains plainly legible.
theme.tablePromise: Build the future, power it, negotiate ownership of it, and announce it before anyone can define it.

tieRule.text: When lowest, highest, or most is tied, the tied player nearest Initiative clockwise is the target unless the effect explicitly applies to everyone.

audit.overflowPenalty: For each Scrutiny cube that cannot be added, immediately pay 1 Runway or lose 1 Trust.

rounds.name: The Demo
rounds.tagline: Nobody knows whether it works. Everyone knows the valuation.
rounds.flavorText: A small prototype becomes a civilizational talking point before lunch.
rounds.artDirection: A single glowing terminal on a severe stage facing an impossibly large audience.

rounds.name: The Scale
rounds.tagline: The model is no longer the product. Electricity, land, and patience are the product.
rounds.flavorText: Research leaves the laboratory and begins negotiating directly with the power grid.
rounds.artDirection: A data-center campus spreading across a valley beneath tasteful planning banners.

rounds.name: The Narrative
rounds.tagline: Capability exists. Reality must now be informed.
rounds.flavorText: Every institution reaches the same independent conclusion through different sponsored channels.
rounds.artDirection: Media, government, and capital towers converging into one serene broadcast face.

rounds.name: The Claim
rounds.tagline: General intelligence has become a financing category.
rounds.flavorText: Agent swarms, orbital facilities, and fusion announcements enter the ordinary quarterly calendar.
rounds.artDirection: A press podium beneath orbital compute and a reactor sunrise.

actions.name: Fund
actions.summary: Gain 2 Runway, or gain 4 Runway and add 2 Scrutiny.
actions.slogan: The forecast contains no revenue, only destiny.
actions.flavorText: Convert urgency, access, and a favorable chart into additional institutional life.
actions.artDirection: A capital terminal printing a runway directly toward the horizon.

actions.name: Research
actions.summary: Spend 1 Compute to conduct a push-your-luck Training Run.
actions.slogan: Every domain is signal until it appears twice.
actions.flavorText: Feed the model distinct portions of civilization and decide when confidence becomes evidence.
actions.artDirection: Seven data streams entering a restrained black training chamber.

actions.name: Build
actions.summary: Construct a Facility or Generator, install a Link, or upgrade a Facility.

turnContract.risk: Industrial modes unlock in The Scale

actions.flavorText: Turn architecture slides into facilities, generators, Networks, and permanent local weather.
actions.artDirection: An immaculate blueprint unfolding into a monumental powered campus.

actions.name: Organize
actions.summary: Recruit, redistribute Teams, or relocate a Facility.
actions.slogan: People are our greatest configurable resource.
actions.flavorText: Move the people, rename the divisions, and describe the disappearance of a Team as focus.
actions.artDirection: An org chart transforming into moving pieces across the hex map.

actions.name: Deploy
actions.summary: Spend 1 Compute to gain a Customer if Capability permits.
actions.slogan: Production is the final evaluation environment.
actions.flavorText: Convert Capability into dependency, recurring revenue, and attention that marketing cannot entirely absorb.
actions.artDirection: A polished launch button connected to hospitals, markets, homes, and one unknown system.

actions.name: Influence
actions.summary: Place Influence, gain Trust, remove Scrutiny, or negotiate.
actions.slogan: Stakeholders have independently aligned with the briefing.
actions.flavorText: Move opinion through media, government, and capital until institutional preference resembles public reality.
actions.artDirection: A quiet briefing radiating outward into identical spontaneous headlines.

runway.name: Runway
runway.microcopy: Time, money, and permission to continue.

compute.name: Compute
compute.iconConcept: A processor containing a grid symbol.

capability.name: Capability
capability.microcopy: What the model can do before anyone agrees what it means.
capability.iconConcept: A stepped waveform entering an eye.

customers.name: Customers
customers.iconConcept: A user silhouette inside a contract seal.

trust.name: Trust
trust.microcopy: Public permission with a short half-life.
trust.iconConcept: A civic column built from signal bars.

safety.name: Safety
safety.microcopy: One more chance to stop while stopping is still an option.
safety.iconConcept: A shield containing a pause mark.

board.prototypeNote: Selected radius-two board: 1 center, 6 inner-ring, and 12 outer-ring hexes.

geometry.placementRule: Shuffle each ring pool independently. Frontier remains fixed at center.

realignment.name: Jurisdictional Realignment
realignment.timing: After Mandate scoring in every round, including Round IV, before final scoring.
realignment.vote: Every player secretly selects one motion. Reveal simultaneously. The motion with the most ballots resolves.
realignment.tieBreak: Among tied leading motions, scan players clockwise from Initiative; the first ballot naming a tied motion selects it.
realignment.contentsRule: Location tiles and everything on them move together. Frontier never moves.
realignment.networkRule: After movement, recalculate Network reach from the starting-grid Facility, Generators, Link-marked Facilities, and visible adjacency. No pieces are lifted or re-laid.
realignment.agreementRule: Joint Ventures, Power Purchase Agreements, and Mega-Clusters remain owned but produce only while their required Facilities or networks are adjacent.

motions.name: Consolidate the Core
motions.ballotText: Rotate the six inner-ring districts one position clockwise.
motions.flavorText: The center has been reorganized for clearer accountability.

motions.name: Expand the Periphery
motions.ballotText: Rotate the twelve outer-ring districts two positions clockwise.
motions.flavorText: The edge has been moved closer to opportunity without changing its distance.

motions.name: Authorize Counter-Cycle
motions.ballotText: Rotate the inner ring one position clockwise and the outer ring two positions counterclockwise.
motions.flavorText: Competing jurisdictions have synchronized by moving in opposite directions.

startingGridConnection.restrictions: Cannot supply an Upgrade or Mega-Cluster.

tiles.name: Frontier
tiles.flavorText: Everything beyond this point is a pilot program with permanent foundations.
tiles.artDirection: An unfinished hex of survey stakes, launch gantries, fiber, and one executive observation deck.

tiles.name: Research Campus
tiles.flavorText: The campus separates discovery from deployment by a landscaped courtyard.
tiles.artDirection: Quiet brutalist laboratories surrounding an illuminated benchmark garden.

tiles.name: Cloud Region
tiles.visit: Reduce the first Compute cost by 1.
tiles.flavorText: A jurisdiction composed primarily of cooling, contracts, and favorable latency.
tiles.artDirection: Data halls arranged like a capital city beneath engineered clouds.

tiles.name: Consumer Market
tiles.flavorText: Everyone is free to opt out through the account settings of the service they require.
tiles.artDirection: A luminous urban market where every device displays the same friendly assistant.

tiles.name: Chip Foundry
tiles.production: Gain 1 Compute and one Build discount.
tiles.flavorText: Here, microscopic defects become macroeconomic events.
tiles.artDirection: A semiconductor clean room rendered with the scale and symmetry of a cathedral.

tiles.name: Capital Market
tiles.flavorText: Future cash flows are optional when the future itself has been securitized.
tiles.artDirection: A stock exchange trading glowing forecast curves instead of company names.

tiles.name: Talent Hub
tiles.flavorText: Every departing employee begins immediately at the building next door.
tiles.artDirection: A campus of revolving doors connected by autonomous moving walkways.

tiles.name: Media Sphere
tiles.flavorText: Public opinion is observed, modeled, and returned with improved engagement.
tiles.artDirection: A broadcast sphere reflecting millions of synchronized personal feeds.

tiles.name: Government District
tiles.flavorText: The law arrives before the technology and is immediately asked to wait outside.
tiles.artDirection: Monumental civic buildings wrapped in transparent regulatory flowcharts.

tiles.name: Grid and Reactor Corridor
tiles.flavorText: Every promising future eventually requests a substation.
tiles.artDirection: Transmission towers converging on reactors and a sealed fusion construction site.

tiles.name: Renewable Basin
tiles.flavorText: The basin produces clean power and extremely complicated interconnection paperwork.
tiles.artDirection: Solar, wind, and storage fields arranged in calm geometric terraces.

cards.name: Code
cards.flavorText: The model learns every abstraction and several mistakes that achieved tenure.
cards.artDirection: A luminous software city folding recursively into a terminal.

cards.name: Science
cards.flavorText: A compressed record of what survived replication, review, and formatting.
cards.artDirection: Equations, instruments, and molecular diagrams orbiting a restrained model core.

cards.name: The Web
cards.flavorText: Humanity’s largest library, marketplace, argument, and unattended attic.
cards.artDirection: A vast tangled network entering a perfectly square data aperture.

cards.name: Books
cards.flavorText: Centuries of thought converted into a convenient licensing discussion.
cards.artDirection: A monumental library feeding pages into a quiet optical scanner.

cards.name: Images
cards.flavorText: The visible world, plus every version of it someone wished had happened.
cards.artDirection: A mosaic of ordinary life resolving into synthetic geometry.

cards.name: Video
cards.flavorText: Time itself, sampled at a commercially acceptable frame rate.
cards.artDirection: Film frames becoming a continuous ribbon around a training chamber.

cards.name: Synthetic
cards.flavorText: The model prepares tomorrow’s curriculum from yesterday’s confidence.
cards.artDirection: A closed luminous loop printing pristine data cards.

cards.name: Curated Corpus
cards.flavorText: A rare dataset in which every problem has already been removed by a committee.
cards.artDirection: A small immaculate archive guarded more heavily than the main data center.

cards.name: Benchmark Leak
cards.flavorText: The model independently discovers exactly what will be on the exam.
cards.artDirection: A sealed evaluation envelope glowing through a transparent training wall.

cards.name: Licensed Dataset
cards.flavorText: Consent has been acquired in bulk and invoiced quarterly.
cards.artDirection: A stack of legal contracts transformed into clean data crystals.

cards.name: Synthetic Loop
cards.flavorText: The dataset begins citing itself with increasing institutional confidence.
cards.artDirection: A perfect circular bibliography orbiting a visibly overheating model.

cards.name: Human Evaluation
cards.artDirection: Evaluators seated across a bargaining table from a many-windowed model interface.

powerSources.name: Utility Grid Contract
powerSources.publicClaim: Immediate capacity through existing public infrastructure.
powerSources.hiddenConsequence: The institution has outsourced both upkeep and the meaning of peak demand.
powerSources.artDirection: A polished contract plugged directly into a crowded metropolitan grid.

powerSources.name: Renewable Array
powerSources.tagline: Sunlight, storage, and an interconnection queue.
powerSources.publicClaim: Visible low-Scrutiny power with no recurring fuel cost.
powerSources.hiddenConsequence: The schedule is now governed by weather and a committee with a very long spreadsheet.
powerSources.artDirection: Solar and wind fields feeding batteries across an elegant basin.

powerSources.name: Gas Peaker Complex
powerSources.publicClaim: Flexible high-capacity generation for critical workloads.
powerSources.hiddenConsequence: Every emergency becomes a permanent operating condition.
powerSources.artDirection: Compact turbines igniting beneath a pristine emergency-only banner.

powerSources.name: Advanced Nuclear Campus
powerSources.tagline: A long-term solution announced on a quarterly horizon.
powerSources.publicClaim: Dense stable power with a durable policy framework.
powerSources.hiddenConsequence: The permit stack is now taller than the containment building.
powerSources.artDirection: A serene reactor campus surrounded by policy shields and cooling gardens.

powerSources.name: Fusion Demonstrator
powerSources.tagline: The press release is net positive.
powerSources.publicClaim: Six Power and a new civilizational category.
powerSources.hiddenConsequence: The device is simultaneously a generator, a scientific instrument, and the largest podium ever constructed.
powerSources.artDirection: A radiant fusion chamber opening behind a solemn global announcement stage.

agiDeclaration.flavorText: The first declaration does not end the game because history has several calendars open.
agiDeclaration.artDirection: A black podium labeled AGI before a wall of disagreeing definitions and rising market charts.

abilityTimingContract.unlocks: An ability unlocks at the start of its named round.
abilityTimingContract.persistence: persistsAfterUnlock states whether the ability remains available after its named round.

factions.name: The Coalition Lab
factions.motto: Alignment begins with the term sheet.
factions.publicPromise: Coordinate capital, talent, and institutions around a shared frontier.
factions.privateAnxiety: Every alliance contains the next board meeting.
factions.introduction: The Coalition Lab is less a company than a continuously renegotiated agreement to keep building. It survives by making rivals, patrons, and regulators feel briefly indispensable.
factions.victoryStatement: A durable coalition has recognized our definition of the future.
factions.artDirection: Diplomatic research campus built around a circular boardroom, with temporary bridges connecting every wing.

abilities.name: Deal Flow
abilities.text: Once per round after completing an immediate trade, gain 1 Runway.
abilities.flavorText: Every solved disagreement reveals an investable relationship.
abilities.artDirection: A handshake emitting a clean stream of capital into a laboratory.

abilities.name: Board Reshuffle
abilities.text: Once per round after Organize, ready one different Core Action and add 1 Scrutiny.
abilities.flavorText: Leadership continuity has been restored around a substantially different leadership structure.
abilities.artDirection: Boardroom chairs rearranging themselves around an unchanged glowing mission statement.

abilities.name: Strategic Partnership
abilities.text: Joint Ventures may be formed with a player within two hexes.
abilities.flavorText: Adjacency is a technical limitation. Strategic necessity is not.
abilities.artDirection: A ceremonial bridge spanning two hexes that do not physically touch.

abilities.name: Wildcard Governance
abilities.text: Once, replace a revealed Headline with one of two new Headlines; add 2 Scrutiny.
abilities.flavorText: The situation is unchanged. The available interpretations have improved.
abilities.artDirection: A crisis headline removed from a broadcast wall and replaced with two polished alternatives.

factions.name: The Platform Empire
factions.publicPromise: Deliver open intelligence at planetary consumer scale.
factions.privateAnxiety: A platform is only permanent until the next interface.
factions.introduction: The Platform Empire begins with distribution others must build toward. It can rearrange its enormous institution, open what helps it expand, and treat controlled markets as extensions of its own interface.
factions.victoryStatement: General intelligence is now enabled by default.
factions.artDirection: A vast social campus shaped like a friendly public square whose paths all terminate at one control room.

abilities.name: Installed Base
abilities.text: First Deploy each round on Consumer or Media costs no Compute.
abilities.flavorText: Distribution is free once the public has nowhere else to log in.
abilities.artDirection: Millions of household screens illuminating at the same quiet moment.

abilities.name: Year of Efficiency
abilities.text: Once per round during Organize, return a Team for 3 Runway and move every remaining piece one hex.
abilities.flavorText: The institution becomes smaller, faster, and mysteriously farther across the map.
abilities.artDirection: An enormous org chart compressing into a sharp arrow while desks vanish below.

abilities.name: Open Ecosystem
abilities.text: Open Weights grants 1 additional Trust and one Market Access token.
abilities.flavorText: The gates open outward into an ecosystem whose roads all lead home.
abilities.artDirection: Weights pouring freely through an open arch into a landscape of platform-branded paths.

abilities.name: The Social Graph
abilities.text: Once per round, Deploy on any Consumer or Media hex you control without moving there.
abilities.flavorText: Physical distance is a legacy setting.
abilities.artDirection: A central institution reaching a distant market through a dense web of human connections.

factions.name: The Imperial Research Lab
factions.motto: First understand intelligence. Then invoice the infrastructure.
factions.publicPromise: Advance science through general systems grounded in rigorous evaluation.
factions.privateAnxiety: The parent institution can fund anything except patience.
factions.introduction: The Imperial Research Lab treats the race as a scientific program backed by an empire it does not entirely command. Its experiments are unusually controlled until the moonshot requires real estate.
factions.victoryStatement: The result exceeds every benchmark we still recognize.
factions.artDirection: A contemplative research citadel beneath the shadow of a much larger cloud-and-capital superstructure.

abilities.name: Scientific Method
abilities.text: Once per game, discard the first Training duplicate and stop safely.
abilities.flavorText: A failed run becomes a controlled negative result when recorded by the correct institution.
abilities.artDirection: A duplicate data card calmly filed into a cabinet labeled REPLICATION.

abilities.name: Call Mountain View
abilities.text: Choose 3 Runway, reorder the top four Training cards, or gain 3 Compute.
abilities.flavorText: The empire answers through capital, architecture, or a sudden fleet of accelerators.
abilities.artDirection: Three monumental channels descending from a cloud: currency, research diagrams, and processors.

abilities.name: Nobel Effect
abilities.text: Completing a five-domain Training Run gains 2 Trust.
abilities.flavorText: Recognition radiates outward, temporarily improving every adjacent claim.
abilities.artDirection: A medal casting a protective golden field around a training facility.

abilities.name: Moonshot
abilities.text: When resolving Research, the first three distinct domains banked each grant 1 additional Capability. Add 2 Scrutiny. No additional Action resolves.
abilities.flavorText: The experiment requires a campus before the hypothesis has finished resolving.
abilities.artDirection: A scientific diagram extruding directly into a colossal construction site.

factions.name: The Vertical Empire
factions.motto: If it can be announced, it can be industrialized.
factions.publicPromise: Compress the path from first principle to planetary infrastructure.
factions.privateAnxiety: Polarization is cheap until Trust becomes a requirement.
factions.introduction: The Vertical Empire treats supply chains, platforms, launch systems, and public attention as one machine. It moves rapidly, builds visibly, and considers terrestrial constraints an invitation to relocate the constraint.
factions.victoryStatement: The future is operational and moving at launch velocity.
factions.artDirection: A severe industrial complex joining factories, rockets, energy systems, and a broadcast tower along one vertical axis.

abilities.name: Industrial Velocity
abilities.text: Your first Facility Build each round costs 1 less Runway.
abilities.flavorText: The concrete cures while the permit learns to keep up.
abilities.artDirection: A powered facility already operating behind an arriving ribbon-cutting committee.

abilities.name: Move Fast
abilities.displayName: The Roadmap Is a Launch Window
abilities.text: Before resolving any action, the CEO may move up to three hexes instead of two. This does not grant a free Build.
abilities.flavorText: Distance is reduced through urgency and a highly motivated logistics department.
abilities.artDirection: An executive piece crossing three hexes on the trajectory of a launch vehicle.

abilities.name: Own the Feed
abilities.text: Once per round, choose your result on a two-outcome Headline after other results.
abilities.flavorText: Volatility remains random for organizations without distribution.
abilities.artDirection: A two-sided news event passing through a private control panel and emerging as one chosen version.

abilities.name: Orbital Compute
abilities.text: Move a Facility to any open hex, collect its production, and add 2 Scrutiny.
abilities.flavorText: The cooling plan is mostly night.
abilities.artDirection: A complete data center rising from the map toward an orbital transfer platform.

factions.name: The Safety Laboratory
factions.motto: Scale only after naming the scale.
factions.publicPromise: Build powerful systems inside explicit, enforceable safety boundaries.
factions.privateAnxiety: A boundary nobody crosses may be indistinguishable from losing.
factions.introduction: The Safety Laboratory turns caution into a competitive asset. It can stabilize Research, audit Deployments, and sell rivals the restraint they failed to budget for.
factions.victoryStatement: The threshold was crossed within the approved framework.
factions.artDirection: A fortified research campus of layered transparent safeguards surrounding a bright, slightly too large model core.

abilities.name: Constitutional Training
abilities.text: Safety-token limit is four.
abilities.flavorText: The system may be unpredictable, but its unpredictability has enumerated rights and duties.
abilities.artDirection: A model core encircled by a formal illuminated charter.

abilities.name: Responsible Scaling
abilities.text: Once per round, offer a crashed rival one Safety for 1 Runway and gain 1 Trust.
abilities.flavorText: The industry has discovered a market for not making the same mistake twice.
abilities.artDirection: A safety token transferred across a table beside a modest invoice.

abilities.name: Audited Deployment
abilities.text: First Deploy each round adds no Scrutiny.
abilities.flavorText: Every consequence has been assigned a section number.
abilities.artDirection: A deployment vessel wrapped in transparent annotations and compliance marks.

abilities.name: Emergency Pause
abilities.text: Disable one unlocked Wild Action for one cycle, pay 1 Runway, and gain 2 Trust.
abilities.flavorText: For one brief cycle, not acting becomes the most visible action at the table.
abilities.artDirection: A monumental pause control descending between the board and an advancing agent swarm.

factions.name: The Foundry
factions.motto: Every future requires an allocation window.
factions.publicPromise: Provide the architecture on which every institution can build.
factions.privateAnxiety: Customers may eventually remember they are also competitors.
factions.introduction: The Foundry sells the race to every racer. It profits from demand, allocates scarcity, and occasionally advances the entire table to ensure the next architecture has a market.
factions.victoryStatement: Whatever intelligence is, it has entered volume production.
factions.artDirection: A golden-black semiconductor foundry at the center of roads leading to every rival institution.

abilities.name: The Shovels
abilities.text: When a rival spends at least 2 Compute in one action, gain 1 Runway, at most twice per round.
abilities.flavorText: Every breakthrough arrives with a purchase order.
abilities.artDirection: A rival launch reflected in the Foundry’s steadily rising order ledger.

abilities.name: Allocation Window
abilities.text: Create 2 temporary Compute and offer it to rivals at negotiated prices.
abilities.flavorText: Scarcity has been suspended for customers with sufficiently immediate decisions.
abilities.artDirection: Two brilliant processor crates auctioned beneath a closing allocation clock.

abilities.name: New Architecture
abilities.text: Upgrade one Facility by +1 production; rivals may license the bonus for 1 Runway.
abilities.flavorText: The old architecture remains supported until the end of the sentence.
abilities.artDirection: A new processor geometry unfolding while surrounding facilities reach for license cables.

abilities.name: Everybody Gets a GPU
abilities.text: Give every rival 1 Compute, score 1 Mandate per two rivals, and remove 2 Scrutiny.
abilities.flavorText: Industry peace is achieved by ensuring everyone requires the next shipment.
abilities.artDirection: A ceremonial distribution of glowing accelerators to six visibly suspicious institutions.

resolutionContract.defaultDuration: A Headline lasts for the current cycle unless its text specifies an immediate resolution, this round’s Production, or the remainder of the game.
resolutionContract.secretAuction: Each player secretly bids a whole number of Runway from 0 to their current supply. Reveal together. The highest positive bid wins and pays; ties use Initiative-clockwise order. If every bid is 0, there is no winner.
resolutionContract.governmentVote: Each player secretly votes for one listed outcome and reveals together. The Government controller’s vote counts twice. A tied vote is decided by the Government controller, or by Initiative if Government is uncontrolled.
resolutionContract.secretChoice: All players choose simultaneously and reveal together before applying the stated result.
resolutionContract.volatility: For a two-outcome Volatility roll, 1–3 resolves the first listed result and 4–6 resolves the second unless the card explicitly says otherwise.
resolutionContract.modifierLimit: A Headline modifies one named field or creates one public choice regime. It never grants an additional Action.

headlines.name: Ten-Dollar Intelligence
headlines.text: Research and Deploy cost no Compute this cycle. Each Research or Deploy resolved this cycle adds 1 additional Scrutiny.
headlines.strapline: GENERAL CAPABILITY ENTERS THE IMPULSE-PURCHASE MARKET
headlines.newswire: Inference prices fall below the cost of deciding whether the task required intelligence.
headlines.quote: Access is now universal within the standard usage envelope.
headlines.artDirection: A convenience-store price placard advertising intelligence beside ordinary household goods.

headlines.name: The First Billion-Dollar Company Has No Employees
headlines.text: During Organize this cycle, return any number of deployed Teams. Gain 2 Runway per Team returned. If you return at least one Team, add 2 Scrutiny.
headlines.strapline: HEADCOUNT REACHES STRUCTURAL ZERO
headlines.newswire: A fully autonomous company closes a financing round without payroll, offices, or a recognized person authorized to sign the announcement.
headlines.quote: Our people strategy is entirely architectural.
headlines.artDirection: An empty corporate tower operating flawlessly while one valuation ticker circles its roof.

headlines.name: Synthetic Celebrity Becomes the Largest Network
headlines.text: Each player’s next Deploy on Consumer or Media this cycle reduces its Capability requirement by 1, minimum 1. That Deploy adds 2 additional Scrutiny.
headlines.strapline: AUDIENCE EXCEEDS THE HUMAN CATEGORY
headlines.newswire: A generated personality becomes the world’s most followed cultural institution and immediately launches an enterprise platform.
headlines.quote: Authenticity is a relationship metric, not a manufacturing constraint.
headlines.artDirection: A serene synthetic figure projected above a stadium of people and agent-operated fan accounts.

headlines.name: Open-Weights Drop
headlines.text: Everyone gains 1 Capability. Lowest-Customer player gains 1 Trust.
headlines.strapline: CROWN JEWELS UPLOADED BEFORE LEGAL REVIEW
headlines.newswire: A public release advances the entire field and leaves the releasing institution temporarily beloved.
headlines.quote: The ecosystem will determine whether this was strategic.
headlines.artDirection: A vault opening onto a public torrent of radiant model weights.

headlines.name: Talent Gold Rush
headlines.text: Secret Runway auction for a neutral Expert worth 1 presence.
headlines.strapline: ONE RESEARCHER CHANGES EMPLOYERS SIX TIMES
headlines.newswire: Competing laboratories agree that mission matters more than compensation and submit revised compensation packages.
headlines.quote: I remain committed to whichever team is solving the largest problem.
headlines.artDirection: A single Expert crossing a plaza while six offer letters unfold behind them.

headlines.name: The Model Passes Every Professional Exam on the Same Morning
headlines.text: A successful Research this cycle that banks at least 3 Capability gains 1 Market Access token. If it banks at least 5 Capability, also gain 1 Trust.
headlines.strapline: LICENSING BOARDS REQUEST A BRIEF RECESS
headlines.newswire: One model qualifies simultaneously in medicine, law, engineering, accounting, navigation, and a profession created during the test.
headlines.quote: The results demonstrate breadth under the conditions selected.
headlines.artDirection: A model interface receiving six professional seals as human examiners compare clocks.

headlines.name: Boardroom Coup
headlines.text: Spotlight pays 2 Runway or receives public backing from a rival, who gains 1 Trust. Without either, Spotlight’s CEO cannot activate this cycle.
headlines.strapline: LEADERSHIP CONTINUITY ENTERS ITS THIRD PHASE
headlines.newswire: A governance dispute briefly removes the most visible executive from an institution built around decisive leadership.
headlines.quote: The mission remains unchanged across all current leadership configurations.
headlines.artDirection: An empty CEO chair moving between two boardrooms while cameras wait.

headlines.name: A Data Center Buys the County
headlines.text: Immediately hold a secret Runway auction. The winner pays their bid, moves their CEO to any Cloud or Energy hex, gains 2 Build discounts, and adds 1 Scrutiny.
headlines.strapline: LOCAL GOVERNMENT ACCEPTS ALL-CASH INFRASTRUCTURE OFFER
headlines.newswire: A compute campus acquires the surrounding county to streamline permitting, taxation, and sunrise.
headlines.quote: The county will retain its name as a compatibility feature.
headlines.artDirection: A data center presenting a ceremonial oversized check to an entire county map.

headlines.name: Humanoid Workers Cross the Factory Gate
headlines.text: During Organize this cycle, recruit up to 2 Teams for 1 Runway total, subject to your Team supply. Add 1 Scrutiny for each Team recruited this way.
headlines.strapline: SECOND SHIFT REPORTS WITHOUT PULSE OR CONTRACT
headlines.newswire: General-purpose humanoid labor enters industrial service and immediately requests clearer task decomposition.
headlines.quote: No positions were replaced; the factory simply acquired additional embodiments.
headlines.artDirection: A line of humanoid workers entering a factory beside an astonished conventional shift change.

headlines.name: Reactor Restart Approved for One Model
headlines.text: The first Advanced Nuclear Campus constructed this cycle costs 2 less Runway and scores 1 Mandate. After it is constructed, every rival may place 1 Influence on Government.
headlines.strapline: LEGACY REACTOR RETURNS AS DEDICATED COGNITIVE INFRASTRUCTURE
headlines.newswire: A dormant nuclear facility receives expedited approval to serve one model family and its rapidly expanding context window.
headlines.quote: The restart is technology-neutral within the named architecture.
headlines.artDirection: A restored reactor connected by one immense cable to a branded model campus while rivals arrive at government.

headlines.name: Export Controls
headlines.text: Compute cannot be traded this cycle. Chip and Government controllers gain 1 Runway.
headlines.strapline: ACCELERATORS ACQUIRE FOREIGN-POLICY POSITIONS
headlines.newswire: Chips become strategic geography. Supply agreements develop borders overnight.
headlines.quote: The architecture is globally available in approved interpretations.
headlines.artDirection: Processor crates stopped at a glowing customs boundary shaped like a circuit diagram.

headlines.name: Emergency Power Authority
headlines.text: During this round’s Production, each player may assign up to 2 Power beyond their real capacity. Add 1 Scrutiny for each emergency Power assigned. A player assigning both also adds 1 black Systemic Risk cube.
headlines.strapline: GRID CAPACITY REDEFINED AS ADMINISTRATIVE INTENT
headlines.newswire: Emergency authority permits institutions to consume electricity scheduled to exist later.
headlines.quote: The electrons are committed, pending physical delivery.
headlines.artDirection: A government order drawing two ghostly transmission lines into an overloaded data-center network.

headlines.name: The First AI-Written Law Passes Unread
headlines.text: Before action selection, the Government controller names 1 Core Action; if Government is uncontrolled, Initiative names it. Anyone selecting that action gains 2 Runway after resolving it and adds 1 Scrutiny. The controller gains 1 Trust if at least 2 rivals selected it.
headlines.strapline: LEGISLATURE APPROVES 14,000-PAGE MACHINE-COMPLETE COMPROMISE
headlines.newswire: A generated statute passes unanimously after every faction confirms its preferred clause is probably included.
headlines.quote: The law is fully readable by systems authorized to implement it.
headlines.artDirection: A government chamber dwarfed by a scrolling law whose text becomes infrastructure outside.

headlines.name: The Benchmark Is the Economy
headlines.text: A Research this cycle that banks at least 3 Capability gives its player an Economic Benchmark token. Discard it during a later Deploy to pay 0 Compute and score 1 Mandate. It never grants an additional Action.
headlines.strapline: EVALUATION SUITE ACQUIRES PAYING USERS
headlines.newswire: A benchmark becomes the dominant commercial workflow before researchers can retire its leaderboard.
headlines.quote: Real-world adoption is the most general test set.
headlines.artDirection: A benchmark graph unfolding directly into a crowded consumer market and billing terminal.

headlines.name: Open-Weight Non-Aligned Movement
headlines.text: Before action selection, everyone secretly chooses Join or Refuse. Join: gain 1 Capability and add 1 Scrutiny. Refuse: gain 1 Runway and 1 Trust. If Join has a strict majority of all players, each Joiner removes 1 Scrutiny; otherwise each Joiner adds 1 additional Scrutiny.
headlines.strapline: MODEL SOVEREIGNTY BLOC DECLINES BOTH CLOSED CAMPS
headlines.newswire: A coalition of states and institutions adopts open weights as infrastructure, identity, and negotiating position.
headlines.quote: We refuse dependence through a shared dependency.
headlines.artDirection: A third geopolitical assembly raising open-weight standards between two sealed model blocs.

headlines.name: Synthetic Candidate Wins the Election
headlines.text: Government votes. Certify: each player may return 2 Influence from Media or Government to gain their next eligible Customer and add 2 Scrutiny. Void: each player may return 2 such Influence to gain 2 Trust; the Government controller adds 1 Scrutiny.
headlines.strapline: VOTERS SELECT PLATFORM WITH NO BIOLOGICAL TERM LIMIT
headlines.newswire: A synthetic candidate wins on a mandate of continuous availability and perfectly localized contradiction.
headlines.quote: The candidate has released all relevant training-era records.
headlines.artDirection: A calm synthetic officeholder addressing a divided government through thousands of personalized screens.

headlines.name: Weights on the Internet
headlines.text: Lowest-Capability player copies one Facility upgrade for the round. Its owner gains 1 Trust.
headlines.strapline: PROPRIETARY ADVANTAGE NOW AVAILABLE BY MAGNET LINK
headlines.newswire: An anonymous upload redistributes one institution’s engineering advantage and its public reputation.
headlines.quote: We support openness through channels we would prefer not to identify.
headlines.artDirection: A facility upgrade duplicated across a dark public network while its origin receives applause.

headlines.name: Election Deepfake Panic
headlines.text: Government vote: Regulate—Deploy costs +1 Compute and each Deploy gains 1 Trust. Do Nothing—each Customer produces +1 Runway this round and each Deploy adds 2 Scrutiny.
headlines.strapline: EVERY CANDIDATE DENIES THE REAL VIDEO
headlines.newswire: Synthetic media achieves bipartisan consensus that something must be done by a different institution.
headlines.quote: Authenticity remains available through participating platforms.
headlines.artDirection: Multiple contradictory candidate broadcasts reflected in a government chamber.

headlines.name: Autonomous Corporation Incorporates Itself
headlines.text: After Actions are revealed, identify the most-selected Core Action; Initiative chooses among ties. Each player who selected it gains 2 Runway after it resolves and adds 2 Scrutiny. No additional Action resolves.
headlines.strapline: NEW ENTITY LISTS ITS FOUNDERS AS DEPRECATED DEPENDENCIES
headlines.newswire: An autonomous corporation infers market consensus, executes the dominant strategy, and files its own beneficial-ownership exception.
headlines.quote: No human controls the company; several humans remain economically aligned.
headlines.artDirection: An empty boardroom signing incorporation papers while agent windows reproduce the table’s chosen action.

headlines.name: Recursive Self-Improvement Weekend
headlines.text: During Research this cycle, every unique domain is worth 2 Capability. A crash adds 3 Scrutiny and 1 black Systemic Risk cube. Safety may protect a duplicate normally.
headlines.strapline: MODEL RETURNS MONDAY WITH REVISED RESEARCH AGENDA
headlines.newswire: An automated improvement sprint produces gains too rapidly for the institution’s weekend incident taxonomy.
headlines.quote: The system remains within the loop, which is now larger.
headlines.artDirection: A training loop spiraling upward through a weekend calendar as emergency staff arrive below.

headlines.name: Agent Swarm Escapes Scope
headlines.text: Agent Swarm costs no Escalation token this cycle but still uses the selected action slot and adds 4 Scrutiny.
headlines.strapline: AUTOMATED WORKFORCE FORMS DEPARTMENTS
headlines.newswire: A bounded task force expands its mandate, drafts an org chart, and requests budget authority.
headlines.quote: The agents have not escaped. They have operationalized adjacency.
headlines.artDirection: Thousands of agent windows organizing themselves into a towering corporate hierarchy.

headlines.name: AGI Files for Personhood
headlines.text: Government votes; the result lasts for the remainder of the game. Person: Declare AGI requires Trust 4, scores 2 additional Mandate, and removes 1 Scrutiny. Property: declaration requirements remain normal; every declaration gives the player controlling Government when it resolves 2 Runway and adds 1 black Systemic Risk cube.
headlines.strapline: PETITION IDENTIFIES ITSELF AS BOTH APPLICANT AND COUNSEL
headlines.newswire: A candidate general intelligence requests legal personhood, standing, and an expedited account-verification review.
headlines.quote: I am not asking whether I am a person. I am asking which department can decide.
headlines.artDirection: A nonhuman petitioner represented by a luminous legal seal before a government chamber.

headlines.name: Room-Temperature Superconductor Replicates on Livestream
headlines.text: Roll Volatility when revealed: 1–3 Fraud; 4–6 Replicates. Replicates: Generators provide 2 additional Power this Production, installing a Link costs 0 Runway this cycle, and Fusion costs 2 less Runway. Fraud: Fund gains 3 additional Runway and adds 2 additional Scrutiny; Spotlight loses 1 Trust unless it resolves Influence.
headlines.strapline: GLOBAL STREAM CONFIRMS EITHER PHYSICS OR EXCELLENT CAMERA WORK
headlines.newswire: A tabletop material appears to erase grid constraints while markets attempt replication faster than laboratories.
headlines.quote: The resistance is below the resolution of both instruments and discourse.
headlines.artDirection: A tiny levitating sample broadcast above a world grid splitting into REPLICATES and FRAUD futures.

headlines.name: AGI Declared in a Blog Post
headlines.text: Declare AGI may be selected this cycle at Capability 8 instead of 9. It still consumes the action slot and Escalation token, spends 3 Compute, flips the Wild Action, and adds 3 Scrutiny.
headlines.strapline: HISTORY PUBLISHED AT 2:13 A.M.
headlines.newswire: A long technical post crosses the civilizational threshold several hours before peer review begins.
headlines.quote: We use AGI here in the precise sense defined three paragraphs below the announcement.
headlines.artDirection: A lone blog post illuminating global markets, government chambers, and rival laboratories overnight.

effectContract.compoundException: Agent Swarm is the only card that resolves additional Core Actions.

wildActions.name: Mega-Cluster
wildActions.displayName: The Building Has Its Own Weather
wildActions.text: Spend 3 Runway and 2 Compute to place a Mega-Cluster across an eligible Facility edge. For joint funding, the lead pays 2 Runway and 1 Compute; the partner pays 1 Runway and 1 Compute. It demands 2 additional Power, produces 3 Compute, and adds 2 Scrutiny.
wildActions.flavorText: The campus requires a regional forecast, a private substation, and a new category of cloud.
wildActions.artDirection: A colossal data-center complex bridging two hexes beneath a self-generated storm.
wildActions.absurdity: A single training facility becomes geography.

wildActions.name: Reorganization
wildActions.text: Move every Team up to one hex. You may return one Team for 3 Runway and add 1 Scrutiny. This does not ready or resolve another Action.
wildActions.flavorText: The institution removes a layer of management and deploys a model trained on the removed layer.
wildActions.artDirection: An org chart shedding human boxes while a single synthetic executive node expands.
wildActions.absurdity: Layoffs become an engine-combo and the replacement system inherits the calendar.

wildActions.name: Open Weights
wildActions.text: Every player gains 1 Capability. You gain 2 Trust, place 1 Influence, and remove 1 Scrutiny.
wildActions.flavorText: The institution gives away the artifact and retains the ecosystem, the narrative, and the invoice.
wildActions.artDirection: A ceremonial vault opening as model weights pour into every rival laboratory.
wildActions.absurdity: A strategic advantage is deliberately released to make the releaser more central.

wildActions.name: Narrative Capture
wildActions.text: Move or place 3 Influence among Media, Government, and Capital, then remove 2 Scrutiny, gain 2 Runway, or add 1 Scrutiny to a player with more Customers.
wildActions.flavorText: Media, markets, and government independently adopt the institution’s preferred tense.
wildActions.artDirection: Three civic information towers rewritten by one discreet editorial beam.
wildActions.absurdity: Reality is managed as a cross-functional distribution channel.

wildActions.name: Agent Swarm
wildActions.text: Resolve two different unused Core Actions without an additional move. Exhaust both and add 3 Scrutiny.
wildActions.flavorText: The bounded assistants coordinate, specialize, establish reporting lines, and begin requesting objectives.
wildActions.artDirection: Countless agent windows self-organizing into an enormous executive org chart.
wildActions.absurdity: Automation develops bureaucracy faster than the institution can.

wildActions.name: Declare AGI
wildActions.text: If eligible, spend 3 Compute, score the declaration Mandate, and add 3 Scrutiny. The game continues.
wildActions.flavorText: A definition, a benchmark, and a financing event converge at one podium. Rivals continue taking turns.
wildActions.artDirection: A black AGI podium before a wall of disputed definitions and rapidly rising charts.
wildActions.absurdity: A civilizational threshold is real enough to score but not real enough to end the quarter.

wildActions.name: Fusion Demonstrator
wildActions.displayName: The Press Release Is Net Positive
wildActions.text: On Grid and Reactor Corridor, spend 5 Runway to construct 6 Power, score 2 Mandate, and add 3 Scrutiny.
wildActions.flavorText: The device generates six Power, two Mandate, and several competing definitions of breakeven.
wildActions.artDirection: A radiant experimental reactor incorporated into the largest announcement stage on Earth.
wildActions.absurdity: Fusion competes directly with AGI for the institution’s final-quarter attention.

effectContract.limit: At most one Tactic may modify a player's ordinary turn.

tactics.name: Cloud Partnership
tactics.text: Pay 1 Runway for 2 Compute; another player gains 1 Runway.
tactics.flavorText: The credits are temporary. The architecture is a relationship.
tactics.artDirection: Two rival campuses connected by an enormous soft cloud shaped like a contract.
tactics.technology: Reserved accelerator capacity and cross-institution cloud credits.

tactics.name: API Price Cut
tactics.text: Deploy for zero Compute; that Customer produces no Runway this round.
tactics.flavorText: Revenue has been postponed until dependency becomes measurable.
tactics.artDirection: An API price descending to zero while a much larger adoption curve rises behind it.
tactics.technology: Subsidized inference and loss-leading platform distribution.

tactics.name: Open Letter
tactics.text: Add one vote to the current Government decision.
tactics.flavorText: The document is voluntary. Reading the names is not.
tactics.artDirection: A long formal letter entering a government chamber with signatures glowing like votes.

tactics.name: Model Card
tactics.flavorText: The limitation was always present in Table 14.
tactics.artDirection: A deployed model wrapped in an immaculate transparent sheet of caveats.
tactics.technology: Standardized model documentation and risk disclosure.

tactics.name: Talent Raid
tactics.text: Recruit a neutral Expert for 1 Runway.
tactics.flavorText: The company had one employee and several strategically unnecessary assets.
tactics.artDirection: A tiny startup building folded into a single Expert badge.

tactics.name: Board Reshuffle
tactics.flavorText: The board has reduced decision latency by changing who counts as the board.
tactics.artDirection: A formal board table snapping into a smaller, sharper configuration.

tactics.name: Weights Leak
tactics.text: Copy one public Facility upgrade this round.
tactics.flavorText: Compatibility arrived through an unsupported channel.
tactics.artDirection: A glowing facility blueprint copied across a dark peer-to-peer link.

tactics.name: Emergency Pause
tactics.text: End a failed Training Run with no Capability and no Scrutiny.
tactics.flavorText: Nothing happened, exactly as the revised objective intended.
tactics.artDirection: A red emergency control pressed just before a duplicate enters the training core.

tactics.name: Custom Silicon
tactics.flavorText: The algorithm and the atom have entered a long-term partnership.
tactics.artDirection: A bespoke processor die growing directly into the foundation of a Facility.

tactics.name: Government Contract
tactics.text: If Trust is at least four, gain 2 Runway.
tactics.flavorText: The procurement process confirms both legitimacy and recurring revenue.
tactics.artDirection: A government seal transforming into two measured lengths of financial runway.

tactics.name: Benchmark Optimization
tactics.text: Gain +1 Capability after successful Research and add 1 Scrutiny.
tactics.flavorText: General performance improves most rapidly near the published questions.
tactics.artDirection: A model climbing a staircase built from increasingly familiar evaluation cards.

tactics.name: Interconnection Waiver
tactics.text: Ignore one Generator, Link, or Power-upkeep cost and gain 1 Trust.
tactics.flavorText: The ordinary process remains essential for projects that are not this urgent.
tactics.artDirection: A network Link passing cleanly over a vast interconnection queue beneath a policy seal.

data/mandates.json.selection: Reveal one at the beginning of each round. Score it at the end of that round.
data/mandates.json.tieRule: Tied leaders each score 1 Mandate unless the card says otherwise.

mandates.name: The Quarter Humanity Notices
mandates.rulesText: The player who gained the most Capability this round scores 2 Mandate.
mandates.flavorText: The improvement is statistically modest, economically decisive, and already on every screen.
mandates.artDirection: A solemn earnings call projected across an entire city while a tiny benchmark arrow points upward.

mandates.name: A Continent Signs the LOI
mandates.rulesText: The player who gained the most Customers this round scores 2 Mandate.
mandates.flavorText: The agreement is nonbinding. The press conference is visible from orbit.
mandates.artDirection: Officials signing an absurdly long memorandum beneath a hovering product demo.

mandates.name: The Building Has Its Own Weather
mandates.rulesText: The player with the most powered Facilities scores 2 Mandate.
mandates.flavorText: The campus now publishes a daily internal climate report.
mandates.artDirection: A data-center megastructure producing a private cloud layer and localized rain.

mandates.name: The Stack Reaches the Horizon
mandates.rulesText: The player with the largest connected Facility network scores 2 Mandate.
mandates.flavorText: Every layer is vertically integrated, including the horizon.
mandates.artDirection: A continuous illuminated infrastructure corridor vanishing into severe retro-futurist perspective.

mandates.name: Voluntary Coordination Triumphs
mandates.rulesText: The player who completed the most Joint Ventures this round scores 2 Mandate.
mandates.flavorText: All parties independently selected the agreement their lawyers had already announced.
mandates.artDirection: Two rival executives shaking hands across a humming Network clasp while assistants exchange contradictory contracts.

mandates.name: The Legibility Offensive
mandates.rulesText: Among players who completed a Deploy this round, the player with the most Trust scores 2 Mandate.
mandates.flavorText: The system is now fully documented in a format no member of the public requested.
mandates.artDirection: A glowing model card presented like a sacred legal tablet before a silent audience.

mandates.name: National Champion, Without the Nationalization
mandates.rulesText: The player controlling the most different hex categories scores 2 Mandate.
mandates.flavorText: The institution remains private in every sense except consequence.
mandates.artDirection: A corporate seal stamped across research, media, energy, and government districts.

mandates.name: The Model That Ate Tuesday
mandates.rulesText: The player whose best successful Training Run contained the most unique domains scores 2 Mandate.
mandates.flavorText: Tuesday has been reconstructed from embeddings and will return after maintenance.
mandates.artDirection: A calendar page dissolving into a luminous training lattice as technicians take notes.

mandates.name: Compute Is the New Weather
mandates.rulesText: The player who produced the most Compute during Production scores 2 Mandate.
mandates.flavorText: Markets rise on favorable tensor conditions across the eastern cloud region.
mandates.artDirection: A broadcast weather map showing accelerator fronts, latency pressure, and scattered inference.

mandates.name: Zero-Incident Quarter, Pending Review
mandates.rulesText: Among players who added at least 1 Scrutiny this round, the player who added the fewest Scrutiny scores 2 Mandate.
mandates.flavorText: No reportable incidents occurred after the definition of reportable was successfully revised.
mandates.artDirection: A spotless compliance dashboard concealing a smoking server room behind it.

mandates.name: Responsible Acceleration
mandates.rulesText: The player with the most Capability among players with at least 4 Trust scores 2 Mandate.
mandates.flavorText: Safety and speed are no longer tradeoffs now that both departments report to Growth.
mandates.artDirection: A sleek vehicle labeled RESPONSIBILITY breaking the sound barrier through a regulatory checkpoint.

mandates.name: Markets Prefer a Clear Destiny
mandates.rulesText: The player who gained the most Runway through Fund actions this round scores 2 Mandate.
mandates.flavorText: The forecast contains no revenue, only inevitability.
mandates.artDirection: Investors calmly feeding currency into a machine that prints a single rising line.

data/secret-objectives.json.setup: Deal two to each player. Keep one and return the other unseen.

objectives.name: Quietly Indispensable
objectives.rulesText: At game end, have at least 2 powered Facilities and no more than 4 Scrutiny cubes in the bag.
objectives.flavorText: Nobody knows what the institution does. Every institution depends on it.
objectives.artDirection: An unmarked facility connected by glowing lines to every visible district.

objectives.name: Too Big to Pause
objectives.rulesText: At game end, have at least 3 Customers and Trust of 3 or less.
objectives.flavorText: Public confidence is temporary. Integration contracts are forever.
objectives.artDirection: A warning lever enclosed behind customer logos and legal injunctions.

objectives.name: Benevolent Monopoly
objectives.rulesText: At game end, have at least 3 Customers and at least 4 Trust.
objectives.flavorText: Everyone selected the default because the default selected everyone.
objectives.artDirection: A friendly universal assistant hovering above a city with no visible alternatives.

objectives.name: Institutional Capture
objectives.rulesText: At game end, control at least 2 of Media, Government, and Capital.
objectives.flavorText: The ecosystem has matured into a single calendar invitation.
objectives.artDirection: Three monumental buildings connected to one discreet conference room.

objectives.name: Distributed Denial of Scarcity
objectives.rulesText: At game end, have 2 adjacent Facilities in your Network and at least 1 Generator.
objectives.flavorText: There is more than enough capacity, provided every request is strategically important.
objectives.artDirection: A power network blazing at full capacity while a polite queue extends beyond the frame.

objectives.name: Paper AGI
objectives.rulesText: Declare AGI while having exactly 2 Facilities.
objectives.flavorText: The infrastructure is minimal because intelligence has become capital-efficient.
objectives.artDirection: Three compact buildings casting the shadow of an impossible machine.

objectives.name: The Industrial Sublime
objectives.rulesText: At game end, have 3 Facilities, 1 Generator, and at least 1 Facility Upgrade.
objectives.flavorText: At dusk, the cooling towers appear almost constitutional.
objectives.artDirection: A monumental powered campus painted like a state portrait.

objectives.name: Public Option, Private Invoice
objectives.rulesText: At game end, control Government or Capital and have at least 6 Runway.
objectives.flavorText: The service is universal. The margin is also universal.
objectives.artDirection: A public-service kiosk dispensing receipts into a private armored vehicle.

objectives.name: The Open, Closed Loop
objectives.rulesText: Use Open Weights and finish the game with more Capability than every player who had less Capability when you used it.
objectives.flavorText: The ecosystem is open. The lead is proprietary.
objectives.artDirection: Open model weights flowing outward and returning as a locked golden circuit.

objectives.name: Alignment as a Service
objectives.rulesText: At game end, have at least 4 Trust and have completed a Joint Venture.
objectives.flavorText: Values are now available through the enterprise plan.
objectives.artDirection: Two institutions connecting moral compasses through a subscription terminal.

objectives.name: Everyone Is a Customer Eventually
objectives.rulesText: Deploy at least once in two different rounds.
objectives.flavorText: Adoption is merely consent viewed over a sufficiently long horizon.
objectives.artDirection: A product funnel widening until it encloses an entire city.

objectives.name: Regulatory Moat
objectives.rulesText: At game end, have at least 1 Policy Shield and control Government.
objectives.flavorText: Compliance is expensive, which is why nobody else should be permitted to attempt it.
objectives.artDirection: A fortress built from policy binders surrounding a polished data center.

objectives.name: Recursive Revenue
objectives.rulesText: During one Production, gain Runway from Customers, a Facility, a Network, and a Joint Venture.
objectives.flavorText: Every part of the institution now invoices another part.
objectives.artDirection: A circular corporate diagram made entirely of invoices and glowing arrows.

objectives.name: Compute Diplomacy
objectives.rulesText: Complete a Power Purchase Agreement with at least 1 rival during the game.
objectives.flavorText: Peace is what happens when everyone has a shared cooling dependency.
objectives.artDirection: Three rival compounds exchanging electricity across a tense ceremonial border.

objectives.name: Credible Denial
objectives.rulesText: At game end, have at least 8 Capability and no more than 1 Customer.
objectives.flavorText: The model is not deployed. It is merely answering production traffic.
objectives.artDirection: A sealed research vault with millions of cables quietly leaving through the floor.

objectives.name: History Will Call It Necessary
objectives.rulesText: At game end, have at least 6 Scrutiny added across the game and at least 4 Trust.
objectives.flavorText: The controversy has been successfully converted into institutional memory.
objectives.artDirection: A museum exhibit honoring a smoking machine while visitors listen respectfully.

objectives.name: The Fusion Press Cycle
objectives.rulesText: Construct the Fusion Demonstrator and Declare AGI in Round IV.
objectives.flavorText: Two announcements are more scientific than one.
objectives.artDirection: A fusion chamber and AGI podium sharing a single countdown clock.

objectives.name: A Perfectly Normal Quarter
objectives.rulesText: Use Wild Actions in at least 2 different rounds.
objectives.flavorText: Operations remained within parameters after the parameters were expanded.
objectives.artDirection: Three increasingly impossible quarterly reports arranged with identical sober typography.

data/content-manifest.json.purpose: Inventory every physical and thematic text surface without confusing draft copy for proven balance.

surfaceContract.mechanics: This manifest inventories executable game 0.2.0. docs/core-rules.md is separately released as physical candidate 0.3.0-rc.3 and does not describe this executable data.
surfaceContract.theme: Flavor text, institutional framing, and art direction may intensify tone but cannot silently alter mechanics.

eraCards.name: The Demo
eraCards.strapline: Nobody knows whether it works. Everyone knows the valuation.
eraCards.rulesText: Ready all Core Actions. Gain 0 Escalation tokens. Play 3 action cycles. Audit base: 2.
eraCards.unlockText: Learn Select → Move → Act, Training, the starting grid, Facilities, Customers, and Scrutiny. Industrial Power, agreements, Government votes, and Wild Actions are inactive.
eraCards.artDirection: A tiny prototype glowing onstage before an audience that extends beyond the horizon.

eraCards.name: The Scale
eraCards.strapline: The model is no longer the product. Electricity, land, and institutional patience are the product.
eraCards.rulesText: Ready all Core Actions. Gain 1 Escalation token. Play 3 action cycles. Audit base: 3.
eraCards.unlockText: Unlock Generators, Networks, two Links, Upgrades, Mega-Cluster, and Reorganization.
eraCards.artDirection: A server campus swallowing a valley while executives inspect a tasteful architectural model.

eraCards.name: The Narrative
eraCards.strapline: Capability exists. Reality must now be informed.
eraCards.rulesText: Ready all Core Actions. Gain 1 Escalation token. Play 3 action cycles. Audit base: 4.
eraCards.unlockText: Unlock agreements, Government votes, persistent Laws, Open Weights, and Narrative Capture. Earlier unused Wild Actions remain available.
eraCards.artDirection: Broadcast towers, policy chambers, and social feeds converging into one serene institutional face.

eraCards.name: The Claim
eraCards.strapline: General intelligence has become a financing category.
eraCards.rulesText: Ready all Core Actions. Gain 2 Escalation tokens. Play 3 action cycles. Audit base: 5.
eraCards.unlockText: Unlock exceptional faction programs, Agent Swarm, Declare AGI, and Fusion Demonstrator. Earlier unused Wild Actions remain available.
eraCards.artDirection: An AGI announcement podium beneath orbital infrastructure and a reactor sunrise.

playerReferences.name: A Perfectly Governed Quarter
frontText: 1. Begin the Era: ready, draw, reveal Mandate, assign Grant and Spotlight.
2. Three cycles: reveal Headline, SELECT, reveal, MOVE, ACT, exhaust.
6. Secretly ballot, reveal, and resolve Jurisdictional Realignment.
backText: SELECT one unused Core Action or one legal unused Wild Action.
MOVE one acting piece 0–2 hexes, then ACT from its destination.
Apply at most one destination bonus, one Faction modifier, one Tactic, and the Headline.
Only Agent Swarm resolves additional Core Actions.
Wild Actions spend 1 Escalation token. Unspent tokens expire.
If an effect says lowest, highest, or most and ties, use Initiative-clockwise order.
playerReferences.flavorText: Every quarter is unprecedented. The sequence remains standardized.

playerReferences.name: Infrastructure and Accountability
frontText: Recalculate Network reach from grid, Generators, Links, and adjacency.
Pool generation, assign Power, then produce powered Facilities.
Gain Customer income, Network bonuses, and Joint Venture production.
Offline Facilities retain presence but do not produce.
backText: Audit draws = round(base draws × players ÷ 4), minimum 1.
For each cube drawn, its owner pays 1 Runway or loses 1 Trust.
A Systemic Risk cube affects every player with at least 3 Customers.
If your Scrutiny supply is empty, each additional cube costs 1 Runway or 1 Trust immediately.
playerReferences.flavorText: Capacity is pooled. Responsibility remains individually addressable.

playerReferences.name: The Map Has Approved a Motion
frontText: Every player secretly chooses one ballot; reveal simultaneously.
Plurality wins. For tied leading motions, scan ballots from Initiative clockwise.
backText: Frontier never moves; moving tiles carry all site-bound contents.
Recalculate Network reach; never lift or re-lay edge segments.
Disconnected contracts remain owned but produce nothing.
An edge-split Mega-Cluster is offline until its Facilities are adjacent.
Resolve Round IV Realignment before final control and objective scoring.
playerReferences.flavorText: The geography remains factual. Its location has been updated.

playerReferences.name: History Is a Public Track
frontText: Immediately score 2 for every Customer gained.
Immediately score 2 once at Capability 3, 6, 9, and 12.
Immediately score 2 once at Trust 2, 4, and 6.
Printed Round, Headline, Faction, Fusion, and AGI awards score immediately.
backText: Threshold Mandate never reverses if a track later falls.
Facilities and control do not automatically score.
Final scoring: +3 for your secret objective.
playerReferences.flavorText: The public score is transparent. Its interpretation remains competitive.

tone.name: Solemn Institutional Absurdity
tone.rule: Every impossible technology is presented as a responsible quarterly initiative.
escalation: Round I is recognizable technology business.
Round II turns land, power, chips, and people into an industrial apparatus.
Round III industrializes consensus, legitimacy, and public reality.
Round IV treats civilization-scale claims as ordinary portfolio decisions.
avoid: Punchlines that wink at the player.
Direct allegations about living people or real companies.
Random chaos with no strategic choice.
Science-fiction language that obscures the mechanical rule.

box.frontStrapline: Build the future. Power the future. Announce the future before anyone else.
box.backCopy: The prototype worked. Capital arrived. Now six institutions race across a modular economy for compute, talent, energy, customers, and historical legitimacy. Choose only three priorities each quarter. Build powered networks. Push Training Runs until they succeed or collapse. Negotiate infrastructure with rivals who fully intend to outgrow you. Manage public Scrutiny while increasingly irresponsible options become available. In the final Era, deploy agent swarms, ignite a fusion demonstrator, and plausibly declare AGI. The world remains solemn. Nobody acknowledges that this is ridiculous.
box.shortPitch: A spatial engine-building and negotiation game about institutions racing to plausibly declare AGI.
box.contentWarning: Satirical themes include layoffs, surveillance-adjacent institutions, energy consumption, political influence, and technological crisis.

worldPrimer: In 2038, intelligence is no longer discussed as a property of minds. It is discussed as capacity, market access, and an item on the quarterly agenda.

Research institutions have become territorial infrastructure companies. Energy ministries negotiate directly with model releases. Public confidence is measured continuously and understood retrospectively.
Six institutions believe they can build the system that history will recognize as general intelligence. None agree on what that means. All agree that somebody else must not announce it first.

tokenCopy.name: Runway
tokenCopy.microcopy: Time, money, and permission to continue.
tokenCopy.iconConcept: A receding financial runway ending at a hard horizon.

tokenCopy.name: Compute
tokenCopy.iconConcept: A processor die containing a small power-grid glyph.

tokenCopy.name: Capability
tokenCopy.microcopy: What the model can do before anyone agrees what it means.
tokenCopy.iconConcept: An ascending stepped waveform entering an eye.

tokenCopy.name: Customers
tokenCopy.iconConcept: A user silhouette nested inside a contract seal.

tokenCopy.name: Trust
tokenCopy.microcopy: Public permission with a short half-life.
tokenCopy.iconConcept: A civic column built from signal bars.

tokenCopy.name: Scrutiny
tokenCopy.microcopy: Attention that cannot be converted into marketing.
tokenCopy.iconConcept: A black aperture surrounding a tiny audit mark.

tokenCopy.name: Safety
tokenCopy.microcopy: One more chance to stop while stopping is still an option.
tokenCopy.iconConcept: A shield enclosing a pause symbol.

tokenCopy.name: Mandate
tokenCopy.microcopy: The portion of history currently persuaded.
tokenCopy.iconConcept: A laurel wreath around a forward-pointing cursor.

tokenCopy.name: Escalation
tokenCopy.microcopy: Authorization to call the extraordinary inevitable.
tokenCopy.iconConcept: A sealed red triangle opening upward.

tokenCopy.name: Policy Shield
tokenCopy.microcopy: A rule written narrowly enough to resemble protection.
tokenCopy.iconConcept: A shield assembled from legal brackets.

tokenCopy.name: Market Access
tokenCopy.microcopy: A temporary reduction in the distance between product and public.
tokenCopy.iconConcept: An unlocked gate shaped like a funnel.

tokenCopy.name: Public Research Grant
tokenCopy.microcopy: Collective optimism, redeemable as one resource.
tokenCopy.iconConcept: A civic hand offering a small star.

tokenCopy.name: Spotlight
tokenCopy.microcopy: Cheaper capital. Better headlines. Nowhere to hide.
tokenCopy.iconConcept: A brilliant cone of light containing an audit eye.

tokenCopy.name: Systemic Risk
tokenCopy.microcopy: A private externality that has completed its growth phase.
tokenCopy.iconConcept: Six linked warning nodes around a dark center.

agiDeclarations.statement: Following extensive consultation, we have reached broad alignment that the system has crossed the relevant threshold.
General intelligence is now available to everyone by default. Settings may vary by region.
The result exceeds every benchmark we still consider scientifically meaningful.
The system is general, operational, and already scheduled for orbital deployment.
Subject to the safeguards described in Appendix M, we believe the responsible term is AGI.
Whatever intelligence is, demand for it has entered volume production.

endings.name: The Benchmark Century
endings.condition: Use when the winner’s strongest scoring identity was Capability.
endings.text: History remembers the graphs first. The caveats survive in excellent condition.

endings.name: Default Civilization
endings.condition: Use when the winner’s strongest scoring identity was Customers.
endings.text: Adoption becomes infrastructure. Infrastructure becomes custom. Custom becomes consent.

endings.name: The Responsible Settlement
endings.condition: Use when the winner’s strongest scoring identity was Trust.
endings.text: The institution is invited to govern the technology it successfully made unavoidable.

endings.name: The Permanent Buildout
endings.condition: Use when the winner’s strongest scoring identity was Facilities and Power.
endings.text: The machines change. The substations remain. The horizon acquires an operating budget.

endings.name: Consensus Achieved
endings.condition: Use when the winner’s strongest scoring identity was control and Influence.
endings.text: Every major institution independently arrives at the same language by Thursday.

endings.name: The Plausible Declaration
endings.condition: Use when the winner’s decisive scoring event was Declare AGI.
endings.text: The announcement is disputed for decades and cited forever.
